article.title: 可口可樂Enjoy Joy節日新片採實拍，重看AI製作選擇
article.summary: 據Marketing Dive報道，可口可樂推出Enjoy Joy節日影片，這次採用傳統實拍方式呈現家庭及朋友相聚。
highlights: 影片由WPP Open X及Ogilvy打造，Paul Dektor執導，Mayan Productions製作。
30秒、15秒及6秒版本會用於電視、數位、串流及社群渠道。
article.why: 當同一品牌在節日檔期選用不同製作方式，創意團隊可按人物表演、場景及版本需求決定哪些段落適合實拍或AI生成。
article.next_step: 在下一個節日brief中逐鏡列出需要真人表演的情節與需變體的畫面，再據此分配製作方法。
article.detail: 作為歷史背景，Marketing Dive在2025年3月10日訪問可口可樂AI主管，回顧2024年以生成式AI重製節日廣告。本次2026年Enjoy Joy報道則介紹導演及實拍製作。兩者的共同問題是節日品牌敘事如何選擇製作技術；新片取向可供團隊討論人物表演與版本需求，並按每個項目的創意要求取捨。
article.title_en: Coca-Cola's Enjoy Joy films use live action, revisiting production choices
article.summary_en: Marketing Dive reports that Coca-Cola's Enjoy Joy holiday films use conventional live-action production for scenes of family and friends.
highlights_en: WPP Open X and Ogilvy created the work, directed by Paul Dektor and produced by Mayan Productions.
The 30-, 15- and six-second versions span TV, digital, streaming and social.
article.why_en: Different production choices within one brand's holiday work let creative teams assess acting, scene and version needs when choosing live action or AI.
article.next_step_en: In the next holiday brief, identify scenes needing live performance and shots needing variations before assigning production methods.
article.detail_en: For dated context, a March 10, 2025 Marketing Dive interview reviewed Coca-Cola's 2024 AI remake of holiday advertising. The 2026 Enjoy Joy report describes a director-led live-action production. Both concern technology choices for seasonal brand storytelling. Teams can assess performance and variation needs against each project's creative requirements.
